items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker for TNF vs Bills due to groin injury; rookie Emmett Johnson will start for the third straight game.
items.why: Groin injury; limited then DNP/out confirmed by team.
items.implication: Start handcuff if rostered; Walker managers need pivot.
items.opportunity: Full workload for backup RB vs Bills.

items.text: Puka Nacua and TE Terrance Ferguson out for the season; Davante Adams timeline mid-December possible.
items.implication: Drop Puka in redraft; Adams becomes primary beneficiary on return.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for Adams and remaining Rams WRs/TEs when healthy.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving this week vs Carolina; since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC have averaged more PPG among RBs.
items.why: Elite recent PPG and soft matchup.
items.implication: Strong start/sit as RB1 this week.
items.opportunity: High snap/usage expected vs poor run D.

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries; injury resurfaced.
items.why: Foot/ankle; DNP midweek after resurfacing in prior loss.
items.implication: Monitor closely; potential GTD or limited snaps; handcuff up.
items.opportunity: Increased role for Chris Rodriguez or backups if limited/out.

items.text: Etienne snaps and routes could be disappointing down the stretch but carry count reasonably high; favorable ARZ/ATL in Weeks 16/17.
items.why: Citing Graziano on situation; timeshare history with other RBs post-contract.
items.implication: RB2/flex with volume floor via carries over receiving; hold for playoffs.
items.opportunity: Carry share stable even if routes low; schedule boost late.

items.text: Derrick Henry target share jumped to 12% and 4.5 rec/game in two games with Brissett (from <6%/1.3); raises PPR floor.
items.why: Pass-catching role expansion with new QB.
items.implication: Higher floor in PPR; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes in addition to carries.

items.text: Week 12 key: Puka/Ferguson season-ending, Colts cut Jones with AR set to start, Tuten injury resurfaces.
Bo Nix on HATE list this week; outside top 20. Expecting heavy Jonah Coleman vs Pittsburgh and insufficient Nix rushing.
items.why: Coleman volume spike without RJ Harvey; Nix rush not compensating.

items.text: Since Rico Dowdle return Week 6, Jaylen Warren only 51% rush attempts and sub-10% targets in 3/5; now mid-low RB2.
items.why: Split backfield post-Dowdle return; utilization drop.

items.text: With Monangai back Week 11, D'Andre Swift 47% snaps/39% rushes and sub-10% targets in 4/5 active games; mid-low RB2.
Trey McBride 39% target share (19 targets) last two with backup QBs but aDOT only 3 yards; volume keeps top-5 TE PPR but efficiency low (11.8 PPG).
items.why: High volume offset by short aDOT without Brissett.
items.implication: Still startable TE1 on volume alone.
items.opportunity: Target share elite even in limited offense.

items.text: Ladd McConkey season-high 38% target share and 20.7 pts in return; averages 17.5 PPG on 20%+ shares when healthy.
items.why: High share on limited healthy snaps.
items.implication: Solid WR option if stays healthy.

items.text: DeVonta Smith 57% target share Week 11; season 36% avg and 50% end-zone targets; role elite despite injuries tanking season.
Emeka Egbuka last among 45 WRs with 50+ targets in YPT (5.0); under 50 yards since Week 3 and sub-12 PPR in 17/20 recent; efficiency fade.
items.why: Poor YPT and recent production collapse.
